patch.value: Typed SDK collection and dependency refusals still name CLI flags: comment/note/file/test/doc entry grammar and unresolved dependency recovery

Found while fixing GH-1655 (pm-gh1655). A probe of 44 create/update options x 4 tokens through PmClient on the 2026.11.3 build shows the scalar refusals now use SDK wording, but two families still speak CLI: (1) collection entry grammar: comment/note/file/test/doc with an empty entry refuse '--comment requires text=<value>', '--file requires path=<value> or a bare file path', '--test requires command=<value> ...', '--doc requires path=<value> ...'; and an empty dep entry refuses '--dep requires id and kind, or a bare item id ...'. (2) dependency resolution: dep ['none'] or ['-'] refuses 'Dependency target not found: <prefix>-none' with next steps that name CLI flags (for example --allow-unresolved-deps) instead of allowUnresolvedDeps. A typed null on a collection option refuses 'create dep must be a string or string array.' without naming the clearDeps/clearComments form. The audience helpers from pm-gh1655 (mutationInputAudience, mutationOptionLabel in core/item/literal-mutation-input.ts) are the intended mechanism.

Typed SDK collection-entry refusals (comment, note, learning, file, test, doc, dep) name the SDK option key and entry grammar, never a --flag, with a spec per family; An unresolved typed SDK dependency refusal names allowUnresolvedDeps (and clearDeps for a former sentinel) instead of CLI flags; A typed null on a collection option either clears it like its clear* option or refuses naming that option; CLI wording for the same refusals is unchanged, proven by the existing CLI specs
Every typed create/update refusal names an SDK remedy
Collection-entry and unresolved-dependency refusals name CLI flags to SDK callers

message: File SDK collection refusal wording follow-up
